يَد|NOUN: an appendage of a body (as of an animal)
أَنْ|CONJ: introduces a verb clause in place of the definite verbal noun
أَنَّ|CONJ: that (introduces an equational clause or a verb phrase)
بَاعَ|VERB: to sell (to agree to transfer goods or provide services)
خَرَجَ|VERB: to move [with مِنْ (min) ‘from inside’] (somewhere) to outside
رَأَى|VERB: to see (to perceive with the eyes)
قَامَ|VERB: to stand up (to rise from lying or sitting position)
بَيْنَ|ADP: between (“in the position or interval that separates two things”)
قَدْ|PART: Indicates nearness in time or recentness
وَعَدَ|VERB: to promise (construed doubly transitive or someone بِ (bi) something)
سَوْفَ|PART: added to an imperfect (present) verb form to express future tense: will
كَيْ|CONJ: in order that (followed by the subjunctive)
